about: Hand-written conformance vectors for the aircraft-size restriction comparison. Shared byte-for-byte between the app (tests/aircraft-restriction-applicability.test.mjs) and ODSS (tests/test_aircraft_restriction_applicability.py). Expectations were written by reading each notice and the ICAO table, NOT minted from either implementation. Notice texts marked 'real' are public NOTAM item E wording held in the governed OFP corpus; the rest are labelled fixtures.

vectors.origin: real: VHHH 1A1868/26, SQ882 09SEP26, 9V-SHP A350-941
vectors.noticeText: TWY E BTN TWY F5 AND TWY F6 DOWNGRADED TO CODE E DUE WIP

expect.sentence: A350-941 is Code E (64.75 m wingspan): within this limit (Code E). Size check only, not a clearance; other restrictions still apply.
